# Pulse AI

> AI-native platform that unifies inbox, CRM, telephony, and marketing automation so small businesses and freelancers can capture leads, reply faster, and grow revenue.

Pulse AI brings WhatsApp, Instagram, Facebook Messenger, Email, Telegram, SMS, and a knowledge-trained AI assistant into one workspace. Teams connect their channels, train the AI on their business, and run campaigns, automations, and analytics from a single dashboard — without switching between tools.

## Product

- **Unified Inbox** — All messages from every connected channel appear in one view. Assign conversations, set status, and reply with AI suggestions trained on your knowledge base.
- **AI Lead Discovery** — Monitor public sources and inbound traffic for buying signals. Leads are scored automatically and pushed into the CRM pipeline.
- **CRM & Pipeline** — Contacts, deal stages, call history, and notes in one place. Linked directly to inbox conversations.
- **Marketing Automation** — Build trigger-based workflows (new lead → tag → follow-up email → notify team) without code.
- **Broadcast & Campaigns** — Send segmented bulk messages over WhatsApp, Email, or SMS with compliance controls and unsubscribe handling.
- **Telephony** — Full VoIP with IVR builder, call recordings, live supervisor monitor, and dialer campaigns via Twilio.
- **Knowledge Base + RAG** — Upload documents or URLs. The AI uses them to answer customer questions and generate context-aware replies.
- **Media Studio** — AI-generated images, videos, and social posts ready to publish from the same dashboard.
- **Industry Packs** — One-click setups for Restaurant, Clinic, Real Estate, Beauty, Gym, and Education — each with pre-built CRM pipelines, automations, and templates.
- **Partner & Reseller Program** — Earn lifetime referral commissions (35%) or manage client workspaces as a freelancer (40% management fee).
- **Progressive Web App** — Installable on iOS, Android, and desktop from the browser. No app store required. Works offline.

## Pricing

- **Start** — €49/month (or less with annual commitment)
- **Growth** — €99/month
- **PRO** — €199/month
- **Enterprise** — €399+/month, custom seats and SLA
- All plans include a 7-day free trial. No credit card required to start.
- Freelancers receive a 40% management discount on client workspace fees.

## Technical

- Multi-tenant SaaS on Supabase (PostgreSQL + Row-Level Security)
- 100+ edge functions (Deno) for AI, webhooks, email, billing, and automation
- AI via Lovable AI Gateway (Google Gemini) for replies, scanning, campaigns, and insights
- Stripe + PayPal for billing; webhook-verified with idempotency keys
- Vercel deployment across three domains: kohablerjeve.top, alfis.re, pulsi.lovable.app
- PWA with Workbox service worker, offline fallback, auto-update
